fields.label: ERPNext Warehouse
fields.description: Auto-created and kept in sync so WMS stock postings can be mirrored into ERPNext.

fields.label: Default Picking Staging Bin
fields.description: Two-Step Picking's shared, order-agnostic first stop (see Warehouse Process Type.picking_strategy) - a Pick task under a Two-Step process type lands here, not the delivery's own staging bin, and a follow-up Sort task moves it on from here once confirmed.

fields.label: ERP Integration (ERPNext)
fields.description: How ERPNext documents reach this warehouse and how the warehouse reports back - the SAP ECC -> EWM delivery replication model. ERPNext keeps orders, valuation and accounting; this warehouse executes.

fields.label: Inbound Replication
fields.options:
Manual
Purchase Order Submitted
Purchase Receipt Draft
fields.description: Manual: a user creates the Inbound Delivery (button on the Purchase Order). Purchase Order Submitted: every submitted PO line for this warehouse becomes an Inbound Delivery automatically. Purchase Receipt Draft: a draft Purchase Receipt (an ASN) becomes the Inbound Delivery and the Goods Receipt later submits that same Purchase Receipt.

fields.label: Outbound Replication
fields.options:
Manual
Sales Order Submitted
Delivery Note Draft
fields.description: Manual: a user creates the Outbound Delivery (button on the Sales Order). Sales Order Submitted: every submitted SO line for this warehouse becomes an Outbound Delivery automatically. Delivery Note Draft: a draft Delivery Note (the ECC delivery) becomes the Outbound Delivery and the Goods Issue later submits that same Delivery Note.

fields.label: Release Replicated Deliveries
fields.description: Submit deliveries created by replication so they are ready for execution straight away.

fields.label: Outbound Follow-up on Release
fields.options:
None
Allocate
Allocate and Create Pick Tasks
fields.description: What happens to a released Outbound Delivery without a wave: nothing (a planner allocates later), allocate stock, or allocate and create pick tasks.

fields.label: Order Change Policy
fields.options:
Adapt Until Execution Starts
Block Changes After Replication
fields.description: What an edit or cancellation of the ERPNext order does once it has been replicated: follow it into the WMS delivery while nothing has been allocated/received yet, or refuse it.

fields.label: Close Order Remainder on Short Completion
fields.description: When a delivery is completed short (supplier under-delivered, or the warehouse closed it short), close the ERPNext Purchase/Sales Order so the remainder is not delivered again.

fields.label: ERPNext Posting Mode
fields.description: Synchronous: the ERPNext document posts inside the warehouse transaction, and an ERPNext error stops the warehouse posting. Queued with Retry: the warehouse posts first and the ERPNext document follows in the background, retried automatically and listed in WMS ERP Sync Log if it keeps failing.

fields.label: Stage Components
fields.description: When the component (or kit) stock is moved from storage to the kitting work center by warehouse tasks. Manually: the operator starts it from the RF Kitting screen.

fields.label: Put Away Kitting Output
fields.description: After completion, the produced kits (or components when disassembling) get a putaway task from the work center.

fields.label: Kitting Output HU Required
fields.description: The operator must scan a Handling Unit to put the output on when completing a kitting order.

fields.label: Load Sequence Check
fields.description: Loading a Handling Unit for an earlier stop while HUs for a later stop are still waiting (they belong deeper in the truck): Warn asks the loader to confirm, Block refuses it.
